idea-plugin.name: Open in TotalCmd
idea-plugin.description: Open the current file or folder in Total Commander Before using it, set the absolute path of TOTALCMD64.EXE and the window panel after opening in Settings -> Other Settings -> OpenInTotalCmd. 在Total Commander中打开当前文件或者文件夹 使用之前，请在设置->其他设置->OpenInTotalCmd，设置TOTALCMD64.EXE的绝对路径，以及打开后的窗口面板
